source_policy: Official provider resources only; no live account qualification.

rows.name: Saturn Cloud
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA GPUs; model depends on account and instance
rows.free_offer: Advertised 150 compute hours monthly, CPU/GPU, no card
rows.offer_notes: Official 150-hour announcement supersedes historical 30-hour tier. Actual GPU configuration allowance and capacity require account verification.
rows.limits: Free-tier machine eligibility, runtime and actual remaining allocation require verification.

rows.name: Tencent Cloud Studio
rows.training_mode: Custom projects and notebooks; framework qualification pending
rows.free_offer: 20 initial machine-hours after account binding; 2 daily claimable units valid seven days
rows.offer_notes: Units are configuration-dependent, not universal GPU wall-clock hours. Bound account automatically bills after allowance depletion.
rows.interface: Browser IDE; integration and billing-limit interfaces documented
rows.limits: IDE closure may release resources after ten minutes; billing notifications can lag two hours. Requires Tencent account binding.

rows.name: Baidu AI Studio
rows.training_mode: Educational model training; arbitrary PyTorch qualification pending
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA notebook GPUs; actual configuration account-dependent
rows.free_offer: Free CPU, GPU activity points and level-dependent weekly notebook allowances
rows.offer_notes: Dynamic official honor-system documentation and older FAQs differ. Verify actual account benefits; paid A-coin compute is separate.
rows.interface: Browser notebooks and scripts; lifecycle API qualification pending
rows.limits: Identity, region, framework permission, current points-to-runtime conversion and output retrieval require testing.

rows.name: Huawei ModelArts CodeLab
rows.training_mode: Short interactive model-development and training experiments
rows.free_offer: Free CodeLab experience; initial one-hour sessions with interactive renewal
rows.offer_notes: API distinguishes free DEFAULT CodeLab from billed NOTEBOOK instances. Regional access and GPU entitlement require qualification.
rows.interface: Browser CodeLab; ModelArts API identifies free instance type
rows.limits: One free CodeLab per user; resources/files may be released after 72 hours unused. Paid Notebook disks can continue billing.

rows.name: ModelScope Notebook
rows.free_offer: Initial 36 GPU hours; CPU free without total-time limit
rows.offer_notes: Initial finite GPU grant, not verified monthly renewal. Provider documentation and actual account grant need reconciliation.
rows.interface: JupyterLab, terminal and persistent workspace; assisted integration first
rows.limits: Account binding, identity, expiry, current runtime limits, networking and remaining allowance require verification.

rows.name: AMD Developer Cloud
rows.training_mode: Custom training, fine-tuning and inference on ROCm
rows.accelerator: AMD Instinct MI300X; single or eight-GPU VMs
rows.free_offer: Approved developers receive initial $100 credit, generally expiring after 30 days
rows.offer_notes: Application and AMD AI Developer Program membership required. Allocation discretionary. Current dollar offer supersedes older 25-hour descriptions.
rows.interface: JupyterLab, SSH and prepared ROCm/PyTorch containers
rows.limits: Separate ROCm backend qualification needed. Complimentary-access payment requirements unverified; paid access requires payment details.

rows.name: machine.dev
rows.training_mode: Custom GPU training through GitHub Actions
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA T4G, T4, L4, A10G, L40S; specialized accelerators also offered
rows.offer_notes: Signup says no card; legal terms require payment registration. Current docs use dollars; older pricing retains credits. Storage separately billed.
rows.interface: GitHub Actions workflows and provider GitHub App
rows.limits: Non-paying accounts: one concurrent runner, 30 minutes per job. Spot interruption requires checkpointing; disable optional auto top-up.

rows.name: Akash Console
rows.accelerator: Trial GPUs up to RTX 3090; higher-end GPUs require non-trial account
rows.free_offer: $1 trial credit valid 30 days; no card or crypto wallet
rows.offer_notes: Current quickstart supersedes old $10 announcement. Tiny grant suits integration tests, not a large training budget.
rows.interface: Console containers; Akash CLI and SDK automation paths
rows.limits: Trial deployment maximum 24 hours. Guide says deployments stop after credit exhaustion; persistence/export and provider stock need testing.

rows.name: Thunder Compute
rows.accelerator: Student credit restricted to NVIDIA A6000 or L40
rows.free_offer: $20 student credit automatically with eligible US university email
rows.offer_notes: US university students only; not worldwide or recurring monthly. Card requirement and credit expiry not stated on student page.
rows.limits: Ordinary pay-as-you-go after credit depletion. Snapshot storage bills until deleted.

rows.name: Alibaba Cloud PAI-DSW
rows.accelerator: Specified NVIDIA A10/V100 and CPU instance types
rows.free_offer: 750 compute-unit hours across three months for verified product-new users
rows.offer_notes: Normally 250 units per period; compute units are not GPU wall-clock hours. Offer region/account eligibility varies.
rows.interface: JupyterLab, WebIDE, terminal and native PAI APIs
rows.limits: Continued use after expiry or depletion bills automatically. Trial excludes unrelated PAI products; verify storage and transfer coverage.

rows.name: OVHcloud Public Cloud
rows.training_mode: Native AI Training jobs, notebooks and GPU VMs
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA GPUs; account, region and service dependent
rows.free_offer: Worldwide site: US$200 credit for one month on first Public Cloud project
rows.offer_notes: Country offers vary. Official examples explicitly include GPU notebook and training usage; valid payment method required.
rows.interface: Native AI Training/Notebook services, API, CLI and SSH
rows.limits: Credit depletion triggers automatic payment-method billing. First-project eligibility, actual quota, expiry and ancillary costs require verification.

rows.name: Civo
rows.training_mode: Custom GPU VM or Kubernetes training
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA GPU instances in selected regions
rows.free_offer: $250 introductory credit; generally one month, legal terms specify 31 days
rows.offer_notes: Valid card required. Official FAQ has conflicting expiry descriptions. Broad service-credit wording does not prove a specific account's GPU quota.
rows.interface: Compute/Kubernetes API, CLI and infrastructure automation
rows.limits: Alerts and requested resource quotas are not proven cash caps. Credit expiry can affect invoicing; verify GPU allocation and overages.

rows.name: Scaleway
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA L4, L40S, H100 and other instance families
rows.free_offer: €100 trial voucher for eligible new Professional accounts
rows.offer_notes: Payment method required. Reviewed offer does not explicitly establish GPU SKU coverage, GPU quota or voucher duration.
rows.interface: Instance API, CLI, Terraform and SSH
rows.limits: Credit exclusions, account approval, storage/IP charges and actual GPU entitlement must be verified before free-only classification.

rows.name: IONOS Cloud GPU VM
rows.free_offer: UK GPU signup advertises £200 initial credit for 30 days
rows.offer_notes: Full GPU access requires account activation, payment details and access token. Country offer varies; GPU credit applicability needs account verification.
rows.interface: Cloud API, tokens and VM SSH
rows.limits: Paid activation enables billing. Check credit scope, attached resource charges, GPU quota and overage controls.

rows.name: Amazon SageMaker Studio Lab
rows.training_mode: Custom notebook training for existing eligible customers
rows.free_offer: Existing users: GPU up to four hours daily; CPU up to eight hours daily
rows.offer_notes: Closed to new customers. Separate from paid SageMaker AI and Unified Studio.
rows.limits: Four-hour session maximum, 15 GB storage, 16 GB RAM; capacity not guaranteed. Phone verification/CAPTCHA may apply.

rows.name: Intel Tiber AI Cloud
rows.training_mode: Training/fine-tuning on Intel Gaudi or compatible Intel hardware
rows.accelerator: Intel Gaudi2 and other account-dependent Intel accelerators
rows.free_offer: Paid or coupon-conditional; no broad recurring free training allowance verified
rows.offer_notes: Current Gaudi guide asks for purchased credits or coupon. Older official free-access material does not establish current general availability.
rows.interface: SSH and cloud portal; framework-specific setup
rows.limits: Separate Gaudi/Intel backend qualification; CUDA-only recipes cannot be assumed compatible. Live account/credit entitlement untested.

rows.name: Hugging Face Jobs and Spaces
rows.training_mode: Custom training scripts and Docker jobs; paid GPU Spaces
rows.accelerator: Remote CPU and NVIDIA GPU flavors
rows.free_offer: No general free Jobs compute verified; selected Spaces community GPU grants available
rows.offer_notes: ZeroGPU is short Gradio demo execution, not generic unattended training. CPU-basic compute Spaces creation requires subscription despite zero hourly hardware price.
rows.interface: hf CLI, huggingface_hub SDK and Jobs HTTP API
rows.limits: Pay-as-you-go Jobs; prepaid/billing requirements. PRO/organization subscription for CPU-basic compute Spaces; static Spaces free. Free ZeroGPU hosting exception applies.

rows.name: AMD Research and Academic Cloud
rows.accelerator: AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs; allocation dependent
rows.free_offer: Approved research/academic cloud access up to one year based on proposal
rows.offer_notes: Separate allocation program, not another automatic Developer Cloud signup credit. Approval and intended research determine resources.
rows.interface: Approved cloud access; environment and connection terms allocation dependent
rows.limits: Proposal eligibility, dates, accelerator architecture, permitted workloads and ancillary coverage require award-level verification.

rows.name: Google TPU Research Cloud
rows.free_offer: No-charge TPU allocations for accepted research projects
rows.offer_notes: Application-based, not universal GPU access. Current Google Research directory still advertises program; archived associated repository does not establish closure.
rows.interface: Cloud TPU research allocation; JAX, TensorFlow or PyTorch/XLA adaptation
rows.limits: Recipients expected to publish/share research and feedback. Ancillary VM, storage, networking and allocation duration need award-level verification.
